entities.name: Satellite
entities.rationale: Satellite icon hand-drawn at top-left, above EC2 Spot; source of data flowing into the EC2 Spot ingest/processing. Not inside any container.

entities.name: EC2 Spot
entities.rationale: Orange icon labeled 'EC2 SPOT' at left (669,432). Receives satellite data and writes to S3 and RDS. Not inside any box.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon labeled 'S3' (853,338), annotated with '10yr, ~5 PB, 100GB/day'. Standalone, no container.

entities.name: RDS
entities.rationale: Blue database icon labeled 'RDS' (853,530). Standalone, no container.

entities.name: ElastiCache
entities.rationale: Blue icon labeled 'ELASTICACHE' at top-right (1089,256). Connected to Fargate. Standalone.

entities.name: AWS Fargate
entities.rationale: Orange icon labeled 'AWS FARGATE' (1087,428). Central serving layer connected to S3, RDS, ElastiCache and users. Standalone.

entities.name: Lambda
entities.rationale: Orange icon labeled 'LAMBDA' (1084,596). Connected to S3 and RDS; receives requests related to the hand-drawn tile/chart sketch on the right. Standalone.

entities.name: Users
entities.rationale: White users group icon at right (1266,430), connected to Fargate with a bidirectional arrow. Standalone.

visual_connections.description: Curved pink arrow from the satellite down to EC2 Spot: satellite data ingested for processing.
Pink arrow from EC2 Spot up to S3: processed data stored in S3.
Pink arrow from EC2 Spot down to RDS: metadata written to the database.
Pink double-headed arrow between S3 and Fargate.
Pink double-headed arrow between RDS and Fargate.
Faint curved line from S3 down to Lambda, arrowheads at both ends.
Pink arrow between RDS and Lambda.
Curved pink double-headed arrow between ElastiCache and Fargate on their right side.
Pink double-headed arrow between Fargate and the users icon.
Pink arrow from the hand-drawn tile/chart sketch below the users icon pointing into Lambda.
